question: Should college assignments be individual or group-based?

sources.title: Fictional attendance scenario
sources.text: Fictional test scenario, not a real study. A non-randomized four-week pilot at one college involved 40 volunteers using email reminders. Recorded attendance rose from 70% to 78%. Grades were not measured and there was no comparison group. In a survey of 100 enrolled students, 60 opposed compulsory attendance, 25 supported it and 15 were undecided. Students with documented illness could request exemptions. Transport barriers and enforcement costs were not measured.
